title: Read the total from the right version
starter:
%in   = buffer 4 dtype=i32 slot=0
%out  = buffer 1 dtype=i32 slot=1
%acc  = alloc 1 dtype=i32
%a    = shrink %acc 0 []
%k    = range 4
%cur  = load %a
%iv   = shrink %in %k []
%x    = load %iv
%sum  = add %cur %x
%s    = store %a %sum
%e    = end %s %k
%acc1 = after %acc %e
%tot  = load %a
%o    = shrink %out 0 []
%so   = store %o %tot
%out1 = after %out %so
hints: The loop is fine. Look at the line that reads the total. Which version is its view cut from?
`%a` is a view of `%acc`, the memory before the loop. The memory after the loop is `%acc1`.
Add `%a1 = shrink %acc1 0 []` after the `after` line and change the last load to `%tot = load %a1`.
explain: `%acc1 = after %acc %e` names the accumulator once the whole loop has run, so a view cut from `%acc1` reads the finished total. The view `%a` is cut from `%acc`, the version before the loop, which still holds 0. With the total read through `%a1`, the only use of `%cur` is inside the loop, so it is loaded fresh on every pass.
